meaning: After applying a parameter change, the code re-solves the static problem to steady state and throws a hard error if the adaptive steady-state solver does not converge. So any parameter set that fails to settle aborts the run instead of producing a degraded or partially converged initial condition for the dynamic solve.

could_move.what: Runs that call this path from the fit driver can die mid-optimisation instead of returning a penalised objective, changing which parameter sets are reachable.
Verification and replot runs abort on a non-converged case rather than emitting a flagged result.
The dynamic solve downstream uses u0_ss_new, so the strictness here sets how clean the dynamic initial condition is.
Jugular compression decks that perturb parameters most are the likeliest to hit the non-steady branch.

expectation: Unknown. Whether any deck actually trips the error, and how the convergence tolerance inside solve_to_steady_state_adaptive is set, is not visible in the given context.

check.why: Re-runs the existing verification path for Model_5 without a full re-fit, so it exercises this steady-state branch and shows whether the error fires.
